spans.s:
vidhi
(‘fate’, ‘rule’)
------------------------------------------
This word is used to indicate ब्रह्मा, the creator as also fate in general.
(See ADṚṢṬA.)
In the पूर्वमीमाṁसा system it indicates a rule given by the वेदस्. Such vidhis are of two kinds: sāmānyavidhi (general rule) and viśeṣavidhi (special or particular rule).
The second one applies where the first one has to be set aside. For instance: अहिṁसा (non-injury) is the highest virtue. This is the general rule. However, it does not apply to holy acts such as वेदिच् सच्रिड़िचेस् where animals have to be immolated.
